title: Pine Flat Lake Herbicide Service
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION SOUTH PACIFIC.ENDIST SACRAMENTO.W075 ENDIST SACRAMENTO
detail_text: The Government anticipates issuing a Request for Quote (RFQ) with the intent of awarding a base year and four option years for Pine Flat Lake Herbicide Services. Project Description: The purpose of this contracted project is to acquire herbicide spraying work includes treating vegetation in designated areas at Pine Flat Dam & Lake to reduce fire hazards and ensure public safety at Pine Flat Lake and Dam Project boundaries on U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) owned land. This prospective contract action will be conducted using NAICS Code is 561730 – Landscaping Services. The size standard is $9.5 million. Product Service Code is S208 – Landscaping/Groundskeeping. The solicitation will proceed as a 100% small business set-aside and is estimated to be issued on or about April 14, 2026, with quotes due tentatively on May 14, 2026. The RFQ will be issued on the Government Point of Entry known as www.SAM.gov and will establish a firm quote due date/time. If applicable, the site visit date, time and location will be identified in the solicitation. BE ADVISED THAT THIS PROJECT MAY BE DELAYED, CANCELLED OR REVISED AT ANY TIME DURING THE PRE-SOLICITATION, SOLICITATION, SELECTION, EVALUATION, NEGOTIATION AND/OR FINAL AWARD PROCESS. The only INTERESTED VENDORS LISTS (plan-holder's/bidder's list) is available via SAM.gov. Contractors are responsible for self-identifying as interested vendors and viewing other interested vendors. Contractors should check SAM.gov frequently for any changes to the interested vendors list and notice.
